# Local web fonts

Noto Sans SC and Noto Serif SC variable WOFF2 fonts, distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The original license notices are included alongside the font files.

Sources:
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notoserifsc
- https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@100..900&family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@200..900&display=swap

Retrieved on 2026-10-16. CSS comes from the Google Fonts response for Chrome 130 and retains its unicode ranges so browsers download only the subsets needed by the current page. All runtime requests are to local files; no Google Fonts connection is needed by visitors. `public/fonts.css` defines the Notebook Sans and Notebook Serif family aliases and shared font stacks.
